title: indigo_test: end-to-end scheduler unsafe-hold scenario with aux_simulator and the Auxiliary Agent
description:
Requested by the owner on 2026-11-23. Add a permanent automated end-to-end scenario to indigo_test/integration/run_scheduler_simulators.py (target test_agent_scheduler_simulators) and run it as an INTERACTIVE SIMULATOR run: defects found in product code (scheduler, Auxiliary Agent, aux_simulator, aux base class or other drivers/agents) are NOT fixed by the worker; each is reported with a proposed fix and waits for the owner's approval. The test code itself is the deliverable of this ticket.

Scenario (private indigo_server, no existing configuration):
1. Load aux_simulator (Weather Station Simulator) together with the drivers and agents the runner already uses (CCD/mount/guider simulators, Imager, Mount, Guider, Scripting, Scheduler agents) plus the Auxiliary Agent. Select the weather station in an aux slot of the Auxiliary Agent; AGENT_AUX_SAFETY.SAFE must become OK.
2. Configure the Scheduler with UNSAFE and SAFE hooks (stored tasks whose execution is observable, e.g. via a message or a marker the runner can check) and a short SAFE_DELAY (fraction of a minute) so the run stays short; upload a plan with at least one task long enough to be interrupted, and START.
3. While a task runs, make the weather unsafe through the aux simulator (e.g. X_SIMULATION_PARAMETERS wind above AUX_WIND_THRESHOLDS STRONG, or lower the threshold). Verify: AUX_WEATHER_SAFETY and AGENT_AUX_SAFETY go ALERT with the reason; the scheduler enters the unsafe hold; the running task is aborted (history entry with result unsafe); the UNSAFE hook runs exactly once.
4. Restore safe weather. Verify the hold does not end before SAFE_DELAY has elapsed, then ends; the SAFE hook runs; the aborted/pending tasks are scheduled again and complete; AGENT_SCHEDULER_STATE counters and history are consistent.
5. Optionally check that a brief unsafe flicker shorter than the evaluation tick still counts (documented behaviour), if cheap.
Keep timings deterministic with generous bounded timeouts; clean up the server and temp dirs.

Also update the stale sentence in indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md (Safety paragraph, ~line 606) that says the Auxiliary Agent 'does not compute it yet', since ticket 0061a92c made it compute AGENT_AUX_SAFETY; and any similar stale statement in PROPERTIES.md's scheduler section.

outcome.summary: Pass. Runs (worktree build): the new case alone 2/2 PASS; full run_scheduler_simulators.py 12/12 PASS; SCHEDULER_SIMULATORS_ONLY=nope exits 2 with 'unknown case' and leaves no temp dir; no temp dirs or servers left (only the owner's pre-existing server, untouched). Assertions checked against indigo_agent_scheduler.c evaluate_safety/hold_remaining and aux_simulator: UNSAFE hook counted once (Starting hook count, hook body marker, history single SUCCEEDED, rechecked after the gust); hold proven not to end early by ended-gust_end >= SAFE_DELAY-1.5 s, the 1.5 s tolerance matches time_t flooring of last_unsafe plus the gust length bound; resumption proven by a second Starting task, DONE, frames == interrupted + 15, retries left 1, message order and counters/history. Gust is sound: set_wind waits for Ok between changes, aux_simulator publishes AUX_WEATHER_SAFETY synchronously in the change handler, duration asserted < 0.5 s from the arrival trace, and a missed gust would time out rather than pass. Default selection unchanged (empty list -> all cases, plan count = len(cases)). SCHEDULER.md text matches agent_auxiliary compute_safety and PROPERTIES.md Auxiliary agent; link path and anchor resolve. Non-blocking notes: (1) SCHEDULER.md:938 and indigo_test/Makefile:2645 still describe the server acceptance test as using only the CCD and mount simulators; could add the Auxiliary Agent and aux simulator. (2) run_scheduler_simulators.py unsafe_hold: the assertion ended - safe_at >= SAFE_DELAY is always implied by the later gust assertion, so the no-gust delay is only checked at the 4 s mark; acceptable because the gust assertion is the stronger SAFE_DELAY contract. (3) fresh_start does not clear the UNSAFE/SAFE hooks or deselect the weather station; harmless while this case is last. (4) SCHEDULER.md 'until a weather source is selected its light is Idle' omits the Idle after a source is lost; PROPERTIES.md, which it links, covers that.

Round 2: all five owner fixes verified. diff master...HEAD touches only SCHEDULER.md, SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md, indigo_test/Makefile and run_scheduler_simulators.py. (1) SCHEDULER.md test overview and Makefile comment name the Auxiliary Agent and aux simulator. (2) Dropping 'ended - safe_at' keeps the SAFE_DELAY contract: no hold end at safe_at+4 s, the gust ends after safe_at+4, and 'ended - gust_end >= SAFE_DELAY*60 - 1.5' implies ended - safe_at > SAFE_DELAY*60 and also proves the restart from the last unsafe report. (3) fresh_start clears UNSAFE/SAFE hooks (waited by the all-items-empty check) and selects NONE in FILTER_AUX_1_LIST (NONE is FILTER_DEVICE_LIST_NONE_ITEM_NAME, indigo_filter.c:130) and waits for it; deselection leaves the SAFE light Idle, which counts as safe with the default SAFETY_MISSING. (4) SCHEDULER.md:606 matches compute_safety in indigo_agent_auxiliary.c:155-225 (no source: SAFE light Idle, property Alert on loss). (5) SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md:34 states the current computation. Runs from the worktree: new case alone 1/1 pass in 47 s; full script 12/12 pass in 231 s. No leftover processes; owner's indigo_server untouched. No findings.

history.text: Implementation started on branch ticket/e4e9b6a9-cba5-49ce-8e28-518c20ad7fdb

Recording the gust reproduction and fix as a ticket note
Check whitespace started

Implementation (interactive simulator run, test only): new case 'unsafe weather holds the scheduler and the hooks run' in indigo_test/integration/run_scheduler_simulators.py; agent_auxiliary and aux_simulator loaded by the runner; SCHEDULER_SIMULATORS_ONLY (previously read but unused) now selects cases. Harness reproduction: the first gust version sent two X_SIMULATION_PARAMETERS changes back to back; 1 of 6 runs timed out because the second change arrived while the property was Busy and INDIGO_COPY_VALUES_PROCESS_CHANGE ignores it by design (framework BUSY guard, not a product defect). Fix: set_wind waits for the value and an Ok state before the next change. After the fix: 8/8 runs of the case alone (46-48 s each), full suite 12/12 in 230 s (baseline before the change 11/11 in 184 s). No product defects found. Environment: worktree built with lib, tools, server and the nine needed drivers; build/share/indigo/indigo_drivers written with indigo_driver_metadata for those drivers only. Not changed, outside the named scope: indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md line 34 still says the Auxiliary Agent's safety computation is under development.
Reviewer launched
Review started
Running the unsafe hold case twice from the worktree
Running the full scheduler simulators script once
Review finished: passed

Owner decision after the passing review: fix all review notes, then commit. (1) SCHEDULER.md ~938 and indigo_test/Makefile ~2645 comment: mention the Auxiliary Agent and aux_simulator in the server acceptance test description. (2) run_scheduler_simulators.py unsafe_hold: drop or comment the redundant 'ended - safe_at >= safe_delay*60' assertion. (3) fresh_start: clear the UNSAFE/SAFE hooks and deselect the weather station in FILTER_AUX_1_LIST so later cases do not inherit the state. (4) SCHEDULER.md:606: say the light is also Idle after the source is lost. (5) SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md:34: replace 'still under development' with the current state (the Auxiliary Agent computes AGENT_AUX_SAFETY from AUX_WEATHER_SAFETY of the selected aux devices).
Review fixes applied; running the unsafe hold case twice and the full script once
